verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only that Solid is built on JSX and TypeScript and ships a TypeScript starter template. Nothing documents automatic type inference for component props or events without annotations, and a community comment notes TypeScript does not catch prop-reactivity pitfalls. TypeScript compatibility is adjacent to this story but is not the inference capability itself.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get automatic type inference for component props and emitted events without writing extra type annotations
